card.name: Open parenthesis in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis or the number just inside it, in a calculation such as the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance formula. Also fires on a parenthesis that opens an equivalent amount after a dose or volume.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance formula
modes.description: Parenthesis around 72 or age terms in the kidney function equation, just before serum creatinine or weight.
modes.example: CrCl = (0.85)(140-age)(weight)/[(72<<)(>>SCr)] where age is in years

modes.label: Equivalent amount in brackets
modes.description: Parenthesis or first digit opening an alternate volume or measure after a dose.
modes.example: Dose Volume of Applesauce or Yogurt 100 mg 10 mL (<<2>> teaspoons) 150 mg
